title: Jude and the Ember
author: Rosalind Delacroix
blurb: Xanthe Underhill, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
